snippet.title: Till The Light | Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for my up-coming steam game: Till The Light.
Release Date: June 16

​You work the night shift at a mysterious convenience store that's anything, but normal, however others say otherwise making you question whether or not you're really the sane one here. Each night after your shift you meet with a guide-like entity in your dreams, helping you slowly uncover the truth surrounding the store, the world you live in, and most importantly who you really are...​

Music: https://pixabay.com/music/modern-classical-halloween-bgmtarantelladark-amp-gothic-piano-248346/
